NITIN KUMAR nitindexkumar@gmail.com| +91-9179900360 | LinkedIn | GitHub | Medium Summary Senior Data Scientist with 7.5+ years of experience leading teams of 3+ data scientists and building advanced analytical tools for Fortune 100 companies including major retailers like Walmart and Tesco. Combines deep technical expertise in statistical modeling and machine learning with proven ability to translate complex data insights into strategic business recommendations for leadership teams

Professional Experience

Tesco - Sr. Data Scientist Demand Transference

Apr 2022 - Present | Bengaluru, India

Delivered automated NLP demand analysis model using fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) including LLaMA-7B with LoRA adapters for sentiment analysis on 10M+ reviews via AWS. Implemented multi-modal RAG system combining product descriptions, reviews, and sales data for enhanced predictions

Reduced manual analysis time for product management teams & improved inventory accuracy by 23%, preventing £2.1M in

annual stockout losses Competitor Deep Dive

Executed competitive intelligence framework for pricing & ranging using XGBoost forecasting model, NLP framework with GPT-4 integration to process market share data for 8+ competitors across UK markets

Delivered weekly trend insights to C-suite executives & reduced pricing decision cycle time from 2 weeks to 2 days, enabling

faster strategic responses High Value Customers

Delivered cross-functional initiative to deploy automated CLTV & high value customer models across UK, ROI & Central Europe markets using Random Forest Regressor & BG/NBD models Safety & Security Scaled customer segmentation from manual quarterly reviews to automated weekly updates Executed end-to-end implementation of behavioral analytics system for internal security, automating theft detection & safety monitoring across 3,400+ stores Reduced shrinkage losses by £8.7M annually while improving colleague safety compliance by 24%

Mu Sigma Inc - Data Scientist Supply Chain Demand Forecast

Dec 2018 - Mar 2022 | Bengaluru, India

Led enterprise transformation by implementing automated ARIMA-based time series forecasting platform, scaling demand prediction from 50 SKUs to 10,000+ SKUs Improved the forecasting accuracy from 82% to 91%

Pricing Engine

Built end-to-end automated data pipeline for Fortune 100 insurance company, leveraging GCP BigQuery & Cloud Storage to consolidate multiple disparate data sources into single scalable solution Automated KPI reporting for 200+ stakeholders enabling data-driven decision making across business units

Claim Handler Performance Analysis & Automation

Led cross-departmental project developing automated performance dashboards using Tableau Eliminating 40 hours of weekly manual reporting across multiple business units & improving claim processing efficiency

Accenture - Application Developer Web development & Optimization

Feb 2018 - Sep 2018 | Bengaluru, India

Built Python-based automation scripts to streamline data feed processing workflows, implementing basic validation checks and error handling for daily data ingestion Reduced manual data processing time & improved data quality consistency, eliminating common formatting errors that previously required manual corrections

Key Skills

Programming : Python, Advanced SQL, R Machine Learning : Time series forecast, Regression, Regression, KNN, K Means, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XG Boost, NLP, Gen AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Fine Tuning, PyTorch, GPT, A/B testing Tools & Platforms : AWS, GCP, CI/CD, GitHub, Snowflake, MS SQL Server, AWS, MS Excel, Alteryx, Figma Visualization : Tableau, Power BI

Education

Bachelor of Engineering (2013 - 17) CSVTU, Information Technology X - XII CBSE (2010 - 12) Delhi Public School Bilaspur, Science

Awards

Tesco - 2nd Rank in Tesco DS Hackathon, Spot Award October 2024, Value Award June 2024 Mu Sigma - Spot Award February 2022, Spot Award October 2021, Sport Award December 2020
